newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Suzuki says to build Swift in Hungary.
newsitem.headline: Suzuki says to build Swift in Hungary.

text.p: Suzuki Motor Corp said on Thursday it plans to start building a version of its Swift car at its Hungarian plant.
Production will start in mid-October and the model will be available in 13 versions, the company said in a statement.
"The new face-lifted Swift will have a strong competitiveness to cope with the severe market situation in Hungary, " Shinzo Nakanishi, sales director for the Hungarian plant Magyar Suzuki Rt, said.
